svg.title: The polling miss pointed toward Democrats
svg.desc: Final polling averages against preliminary state-race results. Positive errors mean polls understated Democrats. The supplied mean signed error is 5.3 points across 34 races.
svg.text: The polling miss pointed toward Democrats
34 Senate and governor races | Line: perfect agreement | Mean signed error: D+5.3
